targets.queryText: SELECT currency AS "Валюта", COALESCE(NULLIF(payment_provider,''),'—') AS "Провайдер", COALESCE(NULLIF(payment_branch,''),'—') AS "Ветка", COUNT(*) AS "Заказов", SUM(base_price - COALESCE(discount_amount,0)) AS "Сумма", ROUND(AVG(base_price - COALESCE(discount_amount,0)),0) AS "Средний чек" FROM orders WHERE payment_status='paid' GROUP BY currency, payment_provider, payment_branch ORDER BY currency, payment_provider
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT currency AS "Валюта", COALESCE(NULLIF(payment_provider,''),'—') AS "Провайдер", COALESCE(NULLIF(payment_branch,''),'—') AS "Ветка", COUNT(*) AS "Заказов", SUM(base_price - COALESCE(discount_amount,0)) AS "Сумма", ROUND(AVG(base_price - COALESCE(discount_amount,0)),0) AS "Средний чек" FROM orders WHERE payment_status='paid' GROUP BY currency, payment_provider, payment_branch ORDER BY currency, payment_provider

panels.title: По дням: заказы, оплаты и выручка в валюте заказа

targets.queryText: SELECT substr(created_at,1,10) AS "День", currency AS "Валюта", COALESCE(NULLIF(payment_provider,''),'—') AS "Провайдер", COUNT(*) AS "Заказов", SUM(CASE WHEN payment_status='paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Оплачено", SUM(CASE WHEN payment_status='paid' THEN base_price - COALESCE(discount_amount,0) ELSE 0 END) AS "Выручка" FROM orders GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1 DESC, 2, 3
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT substr(created_at,1,10) AS "День", currency AS "Валюта", COALESCE(NULLIF(payment_provider,''),'—') AS "Провайдер", COUNT(*) AS "Заказов", SUM(CASE WHEN payment_status='paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Оплачено", SUM(CASE WHEN payment_status='paid' THEN base_price - COALESCE(discount_amount,0) ELSE 0 END) AS "Выручка" FROM orders GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1 DESC, 2, 3

targets.queryText: SELECT substr(created_at,1,19) AS "Когда", substr(id,1,18) AS "Заказ", currency AS "Валюта", COALESCE(NULLIF(payment_provider,''),'—') AS "Провайдер", COALESCE(NULLIF(payment_branch,''),'—') AS "Ветка", payment_status AS "Оплата", base_price AS "Сумма", COALESCE(NULLIF(payment_plan,''),'onetime') AS "План", COALESCE(NULLIF(flow_variant,''),'—') AS "Плечо" FROM orders ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100
